mapper.insert: INSERT INTO financial_transaction_tbl (user_id, spending_category_id, transaction_type, source_type, target_type, transaction_status, amount, created_at) VALUES (#{walletId}, 1, 'CHARGE', 'ACCOUNT', 'WALLET', 'SUCCESS', #{amount}, NOW())

INSERT INTO financial_transaction_tbl (user_id, receive_id, settlement_id , spending_category_id, transaction_type, source_type, target_type, transaction_status, amount,merchant_name, created_at) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{receiverId}, #{settlementId}, COALESCE(#{spendingCategoryId}, 1), 'TRANSFER', 'WALLET', #{receiverType}, 'SUCCESS', #{amount},#{merchantName}, NOW())

INSERT INTO feed_tbl (user_id, target_id, feed_type, content, visibility, feed_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{transactionId}, #{feedType}, #{content}, #{visibility}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT bank_code AS bankCode, bank_name AS bankName FROM bank_tbl ORDER BY bank_code ASC

SELECT accountNumber, bankCode, bankName, MAX(ownerName) AS ownerName, MAX(lastTransferAt) AS lastTransferAt FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(la.account_number, u.phone_number, '110-222-222222') AS accountNumber, COALESCE(la.bank_code, '081') AS bankCode, COALESCE(b.bank_name, '하나') AS bankName, COALESCE(u.user_name, NULLIF(t.merchant_name, ''), '테스트회원2') AS ownerName, t.created_at AS lastTransferAt FROM financial_transaction_tbl t LEFT JOIN user_tbl u ON ( t.receive_id = u.user_id OR (t.merchant_name IS NOT NULL AND t.merchant_name = u.user_name) ) LEFT JOIN linked_account_tbl la ON u.user_id = la.user_id LEFT JOIN bank_tbl b ON la.bank_code = b.bank_code WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.transaction_type = 'TRANSFER' ) sub GROUP BY accountNumber, bankCode, bankName ORDER BY lastTransferAt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
